name: Germany: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Germany package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on EudraLex template v2.0 for submissions from 1 September 2026, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every recruitment tool, call-centre script included where a call centre is used.
One L1 information and consent set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true.
L2 other information material present.
German translations of endpoint-related patient-facing documents in Part II (R area); English sources in Part I.
For every German site: M1 CV (not older than one year), M2 regulatory-training certificates (CTR, AMG, GCP), M2 declaration of interest, N1 site suitability.
Sites, principal investigators, roles and planned participant numbers entered in CTIS (N2).
Radiation authorisation documents under N.
O1 insurer-issued certificate identifying the trial or German coverage, with at least EUR 500,000 per case of death or continuing incapacity; O2 policy terms.
items.applies_when: not (trial.low_intervention with German statutory conditions met)

items.check: P1 compensation statement present, stating explicitly when no payment is offered.
P2 draft sponsor–site contract per site without signatures.
R1 GDPR statement including the German national data-protection confirmation (or a separate document).
S1 biological-samples form, consistent with the protocol, participant information and any secondary-use document.
Proof of fee handled in the CTIS Forms section according to the federal authority's invoicing instructions.
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in German.
Administrative documents are in German or English.
No signatures in uploaded K1, K2, L, M, N1, P and S documents, unless the ethics committee or a selected form requires them; the N1 signature is kept internally only.
Non-German-speaking enrolment: qualified-translation commitment and communication plan included.
Compensation amounts and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Insurer, policy number, contact and obligations identical in O1/O2 and every participant document.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all German national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Germany is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Germany receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (EMA/263067/2023 revised rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).

Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly and unsearchably; author metadata removed; signatures never disclosed.
CCI redaction only after both tests: not in the public domain, and disclosure would undermine a legitimate economic interest.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
